description: Tasmanian public holidays under the Statutory Holidays Act 2000 (Tas), as published by WorkSafe Tasmania (statewide list plus the Hobart-area regional holidays; Hobart Principal Registry basis).

evidence.method: Firecrawl scrape of the official WorkSafe Tasmania public-holidays page on the checked date; page last updated 23 January 2026 and lists 2026, 2027 and 2028.

caveats: Supreme Court Rules 2000 (Tas) r 19 defines 'Court holidays' (New Year's Day; Good Friday, Easter Monday and Easter Tuesday; Christmas Day and the 3 days following; any other day appointed by the Chief Justice) and rr 20, 50 and 51 turn on Court holidays, not public holidays. The table lists public holidays, so it may include days the registry treats as open (unless appointed by the Chief Justice) and omits Chief Justice appointments — confirm with the registry before relying on a rollover.
Easter Tuesday (7 April 2026; 30 March 2027) is published as 'generally Tasmanian Public Service only' and is included because it is a Court holiday under r 19(b).

The Royal Hobart Regatta (9 February 2026; 8 February 2027) and the Royal Hobart Show (22 October 2026; 21 October 2027) are regional holidays for southern Tasmania and are included on a Hobart-registry basis; the Launceston and Burnie district registries observe different regional days (Launceston Cup, Royal Launceston Show, Recreation Day, Burnie Show) that are not included — confirm registry-location holidays.
The Devonport Cup half-day holiday and the other municipal show holidays are not included.
Christmas Day 2027 falls on a Saturday: both Saturday 25 December and Monday 27 December are holidays, and Boxing Day is observed on Tuesday 28 December, as published.
Anzac Day is not substituted when it falls on a weekend: 25 April 2026 is a Saturday and 25 April 2027 is a Sunday, with no additional holiday.
